effective_policy: Applies after founder acknowledgment, which also confirms the -0.05 loss bounds for f35 P - F and f36 WP - S. Until then f35, f36 and f37 cannot support comparative runs, scores or claims, and every earlier run of these suites is instrument evidence. Every result is an internal diagnostic, never a published suite result. A harness fault is retried, struck or voids the run under the entry's rules and is never scored.
rationale: Register three outcome families on the owner's 2026-11-07 request that public outcome benchmarks become first-class: f35 clbench_outcome_over_sessions (CL-Bench database_exploration, pinned upstream; arms no memory, plain folder and Exomem as shipped, the Claude Code plugin with skills, hooks and the documented balanced custom instructions, with bare-MCP and hook-only Exomem as ablations), f36 multidoc_synthesis_outcome (Harvey LAB, 20 held-out matters; arms file search and Exomem as shipped, with bare read tools and graph-off as ablations) and f37 planted_governance_ablation (32 independently authored planted stale or wrong notes, governed against plain vaults with identical page bodies). Freezes the held-out inputs by SHA-256, relative to the outcome run root and held in evaluator custody outside the repository. States the arms, sampling units, measures, blind cross-family judging, the bootstrap and Newcombe method-10 intervals, the decision rules, fault handling and the run holds. No assertion, operation kind, catastrophic assertion or budget constant changes.
